menu.group.areas.title.note: Force menu: heading of a group of settings, a few words. The owner opens it to see its settings.

menu.group.areas.note.text: Area centres and their start points (the rings on the map).
menu.group.areas.note.note: Force menu: the note below the heading of the group “Areas”. It explains the settings of the group.

menu.fixed.label.text: Areas fixed on their start points

menu.seed.label.note: Force menu, group “Areas”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.roomEdge.label.text: Rest length counts to the edge of the cloud

menu.categoryPull.label.note: Force menu, group “Categories”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.categoryRest.label.text: Spring between categories of one area: rest length

menu.groupCharge.label.note: Force menu, group “Categories”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.likeGroup.label.text: Repulsion of categories in the same area

menu.likeGroupCross.label.note: Force menu, group “Categories”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.separation.label.note: Force menu, group “Categories”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.clusterGap.label.note: Force menu, group “Categories”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.reachCap.label.text: Separation: largest counted reach of a cloud
menu.reachCap.label.note: Force menu, group “Categories”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.group.skills.note.text: Springs and repulsion inside a cloud give the cloud its shape.
menu.group.skills.note.note: Force menu: the note below the heading of the group “Skills”. It explains the settings of the group.

menu.standardSkills.label.note: Force menu, group “Skills”: label of a switch.

menu.standardSkills.tip.text: On: a standard skill counts for every station from its station “Standard since” on, also in the time range filter. It gets no lines and no springs, and the panel shows its note. Off: standard skills count only at their own stations, like every other skill.
menu.standardSkills.tip.note: Force menu: tooltip of the setting “Standard skills”.

menu.skillHold.label.note: Force menu, group “Skills”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.skillRest.label.note: Force menu, group “Skills”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.skillRestLabel.label.text: Extra rest length per name width
menu.skillRestLabel.label.note: Force menu, group “Skills”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.cohesion.label.text: Pull to the centre of the category
menu.cohesion.label.note: Force menu, group “Skills”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.skillCharge.label.note: Force menu, group “Skills”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.likeSkill.label.text: Repulsion of skills in the same area
menu.likeSkill.label.note: Force menu, group “Skills”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.likeSkillCross.label.note: Force menu, group “Skills”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.group.lineForces.title.note: Force menu: heading of a group of settings, a few words. The owner opens it to see its settings.

menu.group.lineForces.note.text: Each pair of categories in different areas with a shared station is a spring and pulls both clouds, drawn or not. Its strength is the number of shared stations of all skill pairs, without months. What the map draws, you set under “Lines: display”.
menu.group.lineForces.note.note: Force menu: the note below the heading of the group “Lines: forces”. It explains the settings of the group.

menu.pull.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: forces”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.rest.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: forces”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.group.size.title.note: Force menu: heading of a group of settings, a few words. The owner opens it to see its settings.

menu.group.size.note.text: Text, dots and connecting lines of each level. 100% is the size of today. Larger names need more room, so the layout changes too. A line grows with both levels that it connects.
menu.group.size.note.note: Force menu: the note below the heading of the group “Size”. It explains the settings of the group.

menu.areaScale.label.note: Force menu, group “Size”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.groupScale.label.note: Force menu, group “Size”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.skillScale.label.note: Force menu, group “Size”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.group.lineLook.title.note: Force menu: heading of a group of settings, a few words. The owner opens it to see its settings.

menu.group.lineLook.note.text: One line system for shared use. A line counts once, and its strength is the number of its connections: for Category-category the shared stations of all skill pairs, for Skill-skill the shared stations of the pair. For Skill-category a line runs from a skill to another category, with the shared stations of the skill with all skills of that category, and it has the colour of the area of its skill. The map shows exactly the number that you set, the strongest first. This changes only the picture, no force. The colours apply at once. Each mode has its own values for all controls below the mode. A change of the mode loads its values, and a control changes only the value of the chosen mode.
menu.group.lineLook.note.note: Force menu: the note below the heading of the group “Lines: display”. It explains the settings of the group.

menu.showBridges.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: display”: label of a switch.

menu.lineMode.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: display”: label of a list of choices.

menu.lineMode.category.note: Force menu: a choice of the setting “Mode”, the name of a line mode. It also shows in the messages of the menu.

menu.lineMode.skill.note: Force menu: a choice of the setting “Mode”, the name of a line mode. It also shows in the messages of the menu.

menu.lineMode.mixed.note: Force menu: a choice of the setting “Mode”, the name of a line mode. It also shows in the messages of the menu.

menu.drawnBridges.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: display”: label of a slider with a number field; “3 of 1000” follows it.

menu.drawnBridges.hint.text: More than about 1000 lines can make the map slow.
menu.drawnBridges.hint.note: Force menu: small hint below the setting “The strongest”.

menu.crossAreaOnly.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: display”: label of a switch.

menu.crossAreaOnly.tip.text: Lines inside the same area are left out. This does not change the springs.
menu.crossAreaOnly.tip.note: Force menu: tooltip of the setting “Hide lines inside an area”.

menu.bridgeColorLight.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: display”: label of a colour picker.

menu.bridgeColorDark.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: display”: label of a colour picker.

menu.lineGradient.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: display”: label of a switch.

menu.lineGradient.tip.text: Each line runs from the area colour of one end to the area colour of the other end. Applies to Skill-skill and Category-category.
menu.lineGradient.tip.note: Force menu: tooltip of the setting “Gradient between area colours”.

menu.widthExp.label.text: Width follows the strength to the power
menu.widthExp.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: display”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.bridgeWidthMin.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: display”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.bridgeWidthMax.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: display”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.bridgeOpacityMin.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: display”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.bridgeOpacityMax.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: display”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.bridgeBend.label.note: Force menu, group “Lines: display”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.group.experience.title.note: Force menu: heading of a group of settings, a few words. The owner opens it to see its settings.

menu.group.experience.note.text: A ring around each skill with a station or project: in colour the years of use, full at the set duration. Grey is the aged part, and it grows with the years since the last use. The experience does not go away, it only turns grey. A station counts with all its months, until projects have time ranges of their own. The tooltip names the years and the last use.
menu.group.experience.note.note: Force menu: the note below the heading of the group “Experience”. It explains the settings of the group.

menu.showExperience.label.note: Force menu, group “Experience”: label of a switch.

menu.experienceYears.label.note: Force menu, group “Experience”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.ageingStep.label.note: Force menu, group “Experience”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.ageingPerStep.label.note: Force menu, group “Experience”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.group.collision.title.note: Force menu: heading of a group of settings, a few words. The owner opens it to see its settings.

menu.group.collision.note.text: Nodes collide as circles that hold a part of their name.
menu.group.collision.note.note: Force menu: the note below the heading of the group “Collision”. It explains the settings of the group.

menu.collide.label.note: Force menu, group “Collision”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.collideLabel.label.note: Force menu, group “Collision”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.group.simulation.title.note: Force menu: heading of a group of settings, a few words. The owner opens it to see its settings.

menu.group.simulation.note.text: After about 300 steps only the collisions still act.
menu.group.simulation.note.note: Force menu: the note below the heading of the group “Simulation”. It explains the settings of the group.

menu.ticks.label.note: Force menu, group “Simulation”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.friction.label.note: Force menu, group “Simulation”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.range.label.note: Force menu, group “Simulation”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.group.post.title.note: Force menu: heading of a group of settings, a few words. The owner opens it to see its settings.

menu.group.post.note.text: Steps after the simulation, without physics.
menu.group.post.note.note: Force menu: the note below the heading of the group “Finishing”. It explains the settings of the group.

menu.stepLabels.label.note: Force menu, group “Finishing”: label of a switch.

menu.stepUntangle.label.text: Untangle the clouds and spread them evenly
menu.stepUntangle.label.note: Force menu, group “Finishing”: label of a switch.

menu.lopsided.label.text: Spread evenly from a gap of (× even spacing)
menu.lopsided.label.note: Force menu, group “Finishing”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.clearance.label.text: Smallest gap to skills of other categories
menu.clearance.label.note: Force menu, group “Finishing”: label of a slider; its value follows the label.

menu.stepSidestep.label.note: Force menu, group “Finishing”: label of a switch.

menu.standardLinks.label.note: Force menu: the name of an old switch that a later version replaced. It shows only in the message after an old configuration loads.

menu.label.note: Name of the force menu for screen readers. The force menu is the panel of the owner that sets the layout of the map.

menu.title.note: Heading of the force menu, one word.

menu.run.note: Button in the head of the force menu: runs the layout of the map again.

menu.auto.note: Switch next to “Recalculate”: when it is on, each change of a setting runs the layout at once. One word, small letters.

menu.hide.note: Name of the button ‹ that closes the force menu, for screen readers.

menu.seeds.text: Show and drag the start points
menu.seeds.note: Switch in the force menu: shows a ring for the start point of each area, which the owner can drag.

menu.show.note: Button on the map that opens the closed force menu.

menu.store.title.note: Heading of the section of saved configurations in the force menu.

menu.store.note.text: Saves the computed values under a name: all controls, the line values of all three modes and the start points. “Load” sets them like “Load values”. “For readers” picks the configuration that every other visitor sees.
menu.store.note.note: Note below the heading “Configurations”. “Load”, “Load values” and “For readers” are the names of buttons.

menu.store.connecting.note: State line of the configurations while the page connects to the store of the map.

menu.store.name.note: Placeholder and screen reader name of the field for the name of a configuration to save.

menu.store.save.note: Button next to the name field: saves the current values as a configuration.

menu.store.list.note: Name of the list of saved configurations, for screen readers.

menu.foot.reset.note: Button at the foot of the force menu: sets every setting to the default of the file layout.js. Keep the file name.

menu.foot.favourite.note: Button at the foot of the force menu: loads the first set of values that the owner liked.

menu.foot.browser.note: Button at the foot of the force menu: loads the values that this browser stored at the last visit.

menu.foot.values.note: Screen reader name of the text field that holds all values of the menu as one line of JSON.

menu.foot.copy.note: Button: copies the line of values.

menu.foot.load.note: Button: loads the line of values from the text field.

menu.foot.hint.text: To load, paste a line into the field and press “Load values”.
menu.foot.hint.note: Message line below the field of values, before any load. “Load values” is the button next to it.

menu.seed.name.note: Label above the ring of the start point of an area on the map. {name} is the name of the area.

menu.seed.drag.text: Drag to move the start point of this area
menu.seed.drag.note: Tooltip of the ring of a start point on the map.

menu.value.noLimit.note: Value of a slider at its last step, which means that the setting sets no limit.

menu.count.asNumber.note: Screen reader name of the number field next to a count slider. {label} is the label of the setting, for example “The strongest”.

menu.count.all.note: Value of the count of lines when the map draws every line. {total} is the number of all lines.

menu.count.of.note: Value of the count of lines, for example “8 of 120”. {count} is the number of drawn lines, {total} the number of all lines.

menu.values.notJson.text: The line is not valid JSON.
menu.values.notJson.note: Error after “Load values”: the text field holds no JSON.

menu.values.notObject.text: Expected a line in curly brackets, as “Copy values” gives it.
menu.values.notObject.note: Error after “Load values”: the JSON is not an object. “Copy values” is a button.

menu.values.wrongType.note: Error after a load of values. {list} names the keys with a value of the wrong type, separated by commas, for example “ticks, lines.skill”.

menu.values.noneKnown.text: No value of the line is known: {list}. Nothing loaded.
menu.values.noneKnown.note: Error after “Load values”. {list} names the unknown keys of the line, separated by commas.

menu.quoted.note: A name in quotation marks, inside a message of the force menu. {text} is the name. Use the quotation marks of the language.

menu.list.and.note: The end of a list in a message of the force menu. {first} is the list without its last item, separated by commas, {last} the last item.

menu.load.values.note: Part of the message “Loaded: … , all others from layout.js.” after “Load values”. {count} is the number of settings that the line set.

menu.load.lineValues.note: Part of the message “Loaded: …” after “Load values”. {count} is the number of line values, {modes} the text of menu.load.modes, for example “3 modes”.

menu.load.modes.note: The number of line modes, inside the text menu.load.lineValues. {count} is the number.

menu.load.startPoints.note: Part of the message “Loaded: …” after “Load values”. {count} is the number of start points in the line.

menu.load.done.note: Message after “Load values”. {list} lists what the line set, for example “12 values from the line and 6 start points”. Keep the file name layout.js. More sentences can follow.

menu.who.line.note: Subject of the sentences menu.migrate.newer and menu.migrate.done after “Load values”: the line of values.

menu.who.config.note: Subject of the sentences menu.migrate.newer and menu.migrate.done after a saved configuration loads. It follows the sentence “Configuration … loaded.”

menu.who.browser.note: Subject of the sentences menu.migrate.newer and menu.migrate.done after the last state of this browser loads. It follows the sentence “Last state in this browser loaded.”

menu.migrate.newer.text: {who} has schema {from}, this page knows schema {schema}. The values that this page knows are loaded.
menu.migrate.newer.note: Sentence after a load of values from a newer page. {who} is menu.who.line, menu.who.config or menu.who.browser. {from} and {schema} are version numbers of the format of the values.

menu.migrate.done.text: {who} has schema {from} and was migrated to schema {schema} on load.
menu.migrate.done.note: Sentence after a load of values of an older version. {who} is menu.who.line, menu.who.config or menu.who.browser. {from} and {schema} are version numbers of the format of the values.

menu.migrate.flat.text: The line values outside “lines” are for the mode {mode}.
menu.migrate.flat.note: Sentence after a load of old values. “lines” is a key of the format, keep it. {mode} is the name of a line mode, for example “Skill-skill”.

text.one: {list} has the value inside the area, as before the split of the repulsion.
text.other: {list} have the value inside the area, as before the split of the repulsion.

menu.migrate.split.note: Sentence after a load of old values. {list} names one or more settings in quotation marks; the count of the plural is the number of settings.

text.one: {list} is off, as before this setting.
text.other: {list} are off, as before these settings.

menu.migrate.added.note: Sentence after a load of old values. {list} names one or more new settings in quotation marks; the count of the plural is the number of settings.

menu.migrate.standard.note: Sentence after a load of old values. {oldLabel} is the old switch, {newLabel} the switch that replaced it, both in quotation marks. {oldState} and {newState} are menu.state.on or menu.state.off.

menu.state.on.note: The state of a switch inside the text menu.migrate.standard. One word.

menu.state.off.note: The state of a switch inside the text menu.migrate.standard. One word.

menu.migrate.retired.text: No longer in the menu and skipped: {list}.
menu.migrate.retired.note: Sentence after a load of old values. {list} names keys of old settings, separated by commas.

menu.migrate.unknown.note: Sentence after a load of values. {list} names unknown keys, separated by commas.

menu.migrate.skipped.note: Sentence after a load of values. {list} names keys whose value does not fit its control, separated by commas.

menu.migrate.clamped.text: Set to the end of the slider: {list}.
menu.migrate.clamped.note: Sentence after a load of values. {list} names keys whose number was outside the range of its slider, separated by commas.

menu.between.inMode.note: An item of the list in menu.between.text. {label} is the label of a line setting, {mode} the name of a line mode.

menu.between.text.text: Between two steps of the menu: {list}. The slider shows the nearest step, and the value stays until you move it.
menu.between.text.note: Sentence after a load of values. {list} names the settings whose value lies between two steps of their slider, separated by commas.

menu.config.browserState.text: The last state in this browser
menu.config.browserState.note: Subject of the texts menu.config.noValues and menu.config.notLoaded: the values that this browser stored at the last visit.

menu.config.noValues.note: Error when a configuration loads. {what} is the name of the configuration in quotation marks, or menu.config.browserState.

menu.config.notLoaded.note: Error when a configuration loads. {what} is the name of the configuration in quotation marks, or menu.config.browserState. {reason} is one more sentence, for example menu.values.wrongType.

menu.config.modeLineValues.note: An item of the list in menu.config.missing. {mode} is the name of a line mode.

menu.config.loaded.note: Message after a saved configuration loads. {name} is its name. More sentences can follow.

menu.config.loadedSame.text: Configuration “{name}” loaded, schema {schema} like this page.
menu.config.loadedSame.note: Message after a saved configuration loads. {name} is its name, {schema} the version number of the format of the values. More sentences can follow.

menu.config.loadedBrowser.text: Last state in this browser loaded.
menu.config.loadedBrowser.note: Message after the button “Last state in this browser”. More sentences can follow.

menu.config.loadedBrowserSame.text: Last state in this browser loaded, schema {schema} like this page.
menu.config.loadedBrowserSame.note: Message after the button “Last state in this browser”. {schema} is the version number of the format of the values. More sentences can follow.

menu.config.keepsEntry.text: The saved entry stays as it is until you save it again.
menu.config.keepsEntry.note: Sentence after an old configuration loads and the page migrated its values.

menu.config.missing.text: Not in the configuration and from layout.js: {list}.
menu.config.missing.note: Sentence after a configuration loads. {list} names the values that it lacks, separated by commas. Keep the file name layout.js.

menu.config.missingBrowser.text: Not in the state and from layout.js: {list}.
menu.config.missingBrowser.note: Sentence after the last state of this browser loads. {list} names the values that it lacks, separated by commas. Keep the file name layout.js.

menu.measure.lineLength.note: Name of a measure of the layout in the head of the force menu: the length of each line times its strength, summed.

menu.measure.withReference.note: Value of the measure “Line length × strength”. {value} is the measure now, {reference} the measure with the default values.

menu.measure.lopsided.note: Name of a measure: the clouds whose skills leave a wide gap on one side.

menu.measure.of.note: Value of the measure “Lopsided clouds”. {count} is the number of lopsided clouds, {total} the number of all clouds.

menu.measure.offset.note: Name of a measure: how far the centre of the skills of a cloud lies from its category.

menu.measure.radii.note: Value of the measure “Offset of the skills”. {value} is a decimal number, for example 0.12. The number picks the form: 1 cloud radius, 0.12 cloud radii.

menu.measure.skillCategory.note: Name of a measure: the mean distance of a skill to its category.

menu.measure.categoryArea.note: Name of a measure: the mean distance of a category to its area.

menu.measure.foreign.note: Name of a measure: the categories that lie nearer to another area than to their own.

menu.measure.none.note: Value of the measure “Nearer to another area” when no category is nearer. One word.

menu.measure.time.note: Name of a measure: the time of the last layout.

menu.measure.seconds.note: Value of the measure “Computing time”. {value} is a decimal number of seconds.

menu.measure.computing.note: Shows in place of the measures while the layout runs.

menu.store.noDate.note: Shows in place of the date of a saved configuration that has none.

menu.store.schema.note: Part of the line below the name of a saved configuration. {schema} is the version number of the format of its values.

menu.store.newer.note: Part of the line below the name of a saved configuration whose format is newer than this page.

menu.store.noSchema.note: Part of the line below the name of a saved configuration without a version number.

menu.store.forReaders.note: Part of the line below the name of the configuration that readers see. Small letters.

menu.reader.layoutValues.note: What readers see when no configuration is picked, inside menu.reader.sees and menu.reader.none. Keep the file name layout.js.

menu.reader.sees.note: Line above the list of configurations. {what} is the name of a configuration in quotation marks, or menu.reader.layoutValues.

menu.reader.unreadable.text: The pick for readers cannot be read ({reason}). The map keeps its state.
menu.reader.unreadable.note: Line above the list of configurations. {reason} is the error code of the store, for example “unavailable”.

menu.reader.none.text: No configuration picked for readers yet. Readers see {what}.
menu.reader.none.note: Line above the list of configurations. {what} is the name of a configuration in quotation marks, or menu.reader.layoutValues.

menu.reader.missing.text: “{id}” is picked for readers, but this configuration does not exist. The map keeps its state.
menu.reader.missing.note: Line above the list of configurations. {id} is the id of the picked configuration.

menu.reader.picked.note: Line above the list of configurations. {name} is the name of the configuration that readers see.

menu.reader.pickedAt.note: Line above the list of configurations. {name} is the name of the configuration that readers see, {when} the date and time of the pick.

menu.store.unavailable.text: The configuration store is not available in this view. Everything else works as usual, also “Copy values” and “Load values”.
menu.store.unavailable.note: State line of the configurations when the page has no store. “Copy values” and “Load values” are buttons.

menu.store.noAnswer.text: The store does not answer ({reason}). Reload the page to try again.
menu.store.noAnswer.note: State line of the configurations. {reason} is the error code of the store, for example “unavailable”.

menu.store.loading.note: State line of the configurations while they load.

menu.store.readOnly.text: Read only: this view may not save or delete configurations.
menu.store.readOnly.note: State line of the configurations when the store refuses writes.

menu.store.empty.note: State line of the configurations when the list is empty.

menu.store.exists.note: Question before a save under a name that is taken. {name} is the name, {when} the date and time of the saved configuration.

menu.store.readersSeeNew.text: Readers see the new values at once.
menu.store.readersSeeNew.note: Sentence after menu.store.exists when the configuration is the one that readers see.

menu.store.cancel.note: Button below a question of the configurations: keeps everything as it is.

menu.store.confirmDelete.note: Question before a configuration is deleted. {name} is its name.

menu.store.delete.note: Button of a saved configuration: deletes it, after a question.

menu.store.load.note: Button of a saved configuration: loads its values into the menu and the map.

menu.store.pick.note: Button of a saved configuration: makes it the configuration that every other visitor sees.

menu.store.pickOtherFirst.text: Pick another configuration for readers first
menu.store.pickOtherFirst.note: Tooltip of the button “Delete” of the configuration that readers see, which cannot be deleted.

menu.store.unknownCode.note: Shows in place of an error code of the store that the page does not know, inside menu.store.failed. One word.

menu.store.what.save.note: The write that failed, as the subject of the texts menu.store.refused.* and menu.store.failed.

menu.store.what.pick.note: The write that failed, as the subject of the texts menu.store.refused.* and menu.store.failed.

menu.store.what.delete.note: The write that failed, as the subject of the texts menu.store.refused.* and menu.store.failed.

menu.store.refused.denied.text: {what} refused: this view may not write configurations. Loading still works.
menu.store.refused.denied.note: Error of the configurations. {what} is menu.store.what.save, .pick or .delete.

menu.store.refused.full.text: {what} refused: the store is full. Delete old configurations and try again.
menu.store.refused.full.note: Error of the configurations. {what} is menu.store.what.save, .pick or .delete.

menu.store.refused.invalid.note: Error of the configurations. {what} is menu.store.what.save, .pick or .delete. {reason} is the message of the store, or menu.store.refused.document.

menu.store.refused.document.note: The reason in menu.store.refused.invalid when the store gives none.

menu.store.failed.text: {what} failed ({code}). Try again in a moment.
menu.store.failed.note: Error of the configurations. {what} is menu.store.what.save, .pick or .delete. {code} is the error code of the store, or menu.store.unknownCode.

menu.store.nameMissing.note: Error when “Save” finds an empty name field.

menu.store.saved.note: Message after a save. {name} is the name of the configuration.

menu.store.overwritten.note: Message after a save that replaced a configuration of the same name. {name} is its name.

menu.store.pendingLeftOut.text: Changes in the menu that wait for “Recalculate” are not included.
menu.store.pendingLeftOut.note: Sentence after a save while changes wait for the button “Recalculate”.

menu.store.picked.text: Picked for readers: “{name}”. The map starts with this configuration, also after export and import.
menu.store.picked.note: Message after the button “For readers”. {name} is the name of the configuration.

menu.store.loaded.note: Message after the button “Load” of a configuration. {name} is its name.

menu.store.notLoaded.text: “{name}” not loaded, the message below says why.
menu.store.notLoaded.note: Error after the button “Load” of a configuration. {name} is its name. The message at the foot of the menu names the reason.

menu.store.deleted.note: Message after a configuration is deleted. {name} is its name.
